title: The High Aim 6 Mystery
hook: Sailors off Santa Marta have reported a mysterious bright light appearing without warning for decades.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In June 1995, fishermen off Santa Marta reported a bright object hovering over the sea.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: A local pilot logged a sighting on July 12, noting a silent, disc-shaped craft at a high altitude.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Radar operators at a nearby observatory reported an unexplained echo in August, lasting for a brief period.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: Witnesses described a sudden burst of green light before the object vanished near midnight.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: One theory suggests a classified military test of a high-altitude drone, though officials denied involvement.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 2021, declassified files mentioned a similar sighting in the area, suggesting a possible pattern.

end.line: Could these recurring lights be secret tech or something else?

description: A brief look at the puzzling High Aim 6 sightings and the lingering questions they raise.

facts.claim: In June 1995, fishermen off Santa Marta reported a bright hovering object.
A local pilot recorded a disc-shaped craft sighting on July 12, 1995 at 3,000 m altitude.
Radar operators noted an unexplained echo on August 3, 1995 lasting 45 seconds.
Spanish Ministry of Defense declassified similar 2021 sighting files.
Officials publicly denied any military test involvement in 1995.
